source.title: 171Yb Reference Data
source.formatNote: The official PDF and archived PDF use Table 10. The current HTML conversion numbers the corresponding T2 table as Table 11.

adoptedInputs.powerConvention: Power of the selected pure sigma+ component at the atom; no 2P display conversion
adoptedInputs.sourceConflict: Section 6.3 and the Table 10 symbol label q=0/pi, but the explicitly printed sublevels have Delta mF=+1. Use q=+1/sigma+ for absorption between the stated states. Literal pi for that same pair is forbidden.

referenceCalculation.acceptance: Absolute frequency difference is below the paper's quoted 0.006 MHz uncertainty. This is reference compatibility, not an independent statistical significance test.

validated: Browser channel selection and displayed result
notEstablished: All other transitions, especially unresolved T3 and R2 matrix elements
Finite-field mixing, detuning, motion or decoherence corrections
scope.independenceNote: The published Rabi number and adopted dipole belong to the same reference calculation. No dipole or beam parameter was fitted to the target Rabi number.
